author: Siliconera
text:
Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls Open Beta Includes Episode Story Mode
In addition to various versus modes, the Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls open beta will let us see the story in Episode Mode.

author: Siliconera
text:
Hololive English Vtuber Cecilia Immergreen on Hiatus
Hololive English Justice Vtuber Cecilia Immergreen will be on break longer than expected, with a hiatus running through July and August.

author: Siliconera
text:
New Frieren Figure Looks Like She Worked in a Mine for 300 Years
A figure of Frieren based on the anime episode where she's sentenced to work 300 years in a mine is on the way.

author: Siliconera
text:
Prinny Sugoroku Game Being Localized as Prinny Party
Prinny Party, the NIS sugoroku game, will appear worldwide in 2026 and task us with defeating a Supreme Overboard.

author: Siliconera
text:
Madoka Wears Kyubey Pajamas for a Madoka Magica Figure
A Puella Magi Madoka Magica noodle stopper figure of Madoka Kaname features her wearing Kyubey kigurumi pajamas.

author: Siliconera
text:
Princess Maker-Like Volcano Princess Goes to Switch, PS5, and Mobile Devices
The Princess Maker style game Volcano Princess will show up on the Switch, PS5, and mobile devices later this month.

author: Siliconera
text:
FFXIV Site Updates With Screenshots for Patch 7.55
The 7.55 patch screenshots appeared on the official FFXIV 7.5 Trail to the Heavens site and showed what we can expect.

author: Siliconera
text:
Persona 3 Reload Hero and Aigis Look Up Figures Show Up
The chibi soft vinyl figures will appear in February 2027.

author: Siliconera
text:
Star Ocean: The Second Story R Switch 2 Launches With no Upgrade Pack
A Switch 2 Star Ocean: The Second Story R version is out ahead of the 30th anniversary, but doesn't include any upgrade options.

author: Siliconera
text:
Review: Culdcept Begins Is an Apt Introduction to the Series
Culdcept Begins turned out to be a solid entry in the series and really feels great once you build a good deck and go online.

author: Siliconera
text:
Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse Switch Version Launches Alongside Others
There'll be no delay for the Switch version of Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, though pre-orders aren't open yet.

author: Siliconera
text:
The Duskbloods Closed Network Test Starts August 21, 2026
The Duskblood network test sign-ups start in July 2026 ahead of the closed beta taking place in August 2026.

author: Siliconera
text:
Eevee and Pikachu Cuddle Up for New Razer Headset, Keyboard, and Mouse
The next Razer Pokemon headset, keyboard, and mouse collection pairs up Pikachu and Eevee and seems to be a Target exclusive.

author: Siliconera
text:
Godzilla Sanrio Characters Merchandise Heads to Japan
Sanrio characters like Hello Kitty, Pompompurin, and Cinnamoroll will all dress up as Godzilla for new merchandise.

author: Siliconera
text:
Pokemon Pokopia Gets Zorua’s Hide-and-Sneak Contest Event
Another Pokemon Pokopia event starts soon and involves playing hide-and-seek with Zorua using Transform.
